exactPrompt: Use case: original mobile game sprite. Draw Moon Shadow, our chibi Daoist swordswoman, as exactly THREE transparent walking key poses in one horizontal PNG. Equal square cells with clean transparent gutters and no text or floors. Reference 1 is the exact existing character and view; reference 2 is the native action position/order, reference 3 magnifies native legs and arms. Use references 2 and 3 for action anatomy only. References 4 and 5 set the original hand-painted Chinese Daoist Q finish only. Render silver bob hair, navy and gold hairflower, navy scarf, ivory sleeves, navy coat with brushed gold embroidered moon/cloud motifs, dark blue cuffed trousers, gold-striped navy boots and ONE silver crescent blade held firmly in EACH hand, blades distinct and separated. Preserve exact costume, face or back-of-head and camera across all three panels. Short same-scale body, same head and belt height and consistent proportions. This is a compact steady walk. Arms move slightly and each blade follows its own hand. No leaps, high knees, lunges, oversized feet, detached weapons, shadows, captions, panel lines, backdrop, glow or checkerboard. Actual transparent background, 12% horizontal clear gutter around each character, clean silhouette for small mobile size. Strict frontal with both ears, exactly ref 1. Hairflower and scarf trail SCREEN RIGHT. Keep boots pointing at viewer with toe caps visible, no exposed underside. USE BOTTOM SOURCE ROW. f21: feet level, both flat, both eyes closed in a quick blink and both hands down. f22: eyes open. PLANTED LOWEST boot is on the NO-FLOWER side (screen LEFT). The boot on the flower/scarf side, screen RIGHT, recedes slightly behind the hem and its toe appears slightly HIGHER on the page. f23: no-flower-side boot remains planted at lowest point; flower-side boot recedes farther with toe roughly 35–55px above planted boot in a 724px cell. Lift the screen RIGHT sleeve and the crescent held there slightly together. Stay compact, both boots parallel and forward, no lifted soles, no march or kick. Both blades held in f21/22/23.
